issue.title: Promise already satisfied

comments.body:
"Promise already satisfied" says that `prom->set_value();` is called more than once. And this happens the second time your callback (the lambda you give to `health_all_ok_async(...)`) is called (because this callback will be called multiple times, possibly with the updated "health" status).

So you need to make sure that `prom->set_value();` is called only the first time, and possibly unregister the health callback if you don't need it after that :+1:.

Hi @Katawann 
Sounds good to me. Probably should make sure that the documentation and example are updated with a comment.

Can you add a section that you think would have solved this for you? (PR easy to create by clicking button at top of page). 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5368500/75266015-0b35d180-57f2-11ea-96e5-c262bc37d79f.png)

Perhaps in here https://mavsdk.mavlink.io/develop/en/guide/telemetry.html#blocking-telemetry-requests-state-management

Sure!

I close this issue and update the doc according to this
